comparison.objective: Fit a blanking panel at the correct server-rack unit; candidate commissions a robot-axis damper through iterative dynamic tuning.
comparison.physical_skill: Panel transport and simultaneous two-peg alignment versus hex-key engagement, collar rotation, counterholding, locking, and cycle actuation.
comparison.success_condition: Panel seated at U6 and released; no damper energy, stroke, rebound, overload, lock-drift, or repeated-cycle criteria.
comparison.reason: Both involve alignment, but they test materially different abilities: rack insertion versus adjustment and validation of dynamic energy absorption.
